independent.summary: LEO-109's prescribed fetch is internally inconsistent with the paging it must preserve: it cites "again for every infinite-scroll page" as part of the cost, but a projected `messages: { $slice: -PAGE_SIZE }` + count read can only serve the newest page — the `before` cursor path (widget/chatbot.js:328-340 calls /chat/history with `before` for older pages) needs messages before an arbitrary timestamp, and the item's DB-level verify only asserts the last-20 first-open case, so building it as written could silently break back-paging.

summary: The local review mistook the backlog items' own documented bugs for defects in the change — all eight findings (two of them duplicates) are restatements of the filed item bodies on files this FEATURES.md-only diff never touches — and its triage marked auth and destructive touched on that same confusion, while missing the one genuine issue, LEO-109's fetch plan conflicting with the `before` paging it must preserve.
